ledger: 00:00-00:06: Interior hallway/foyer corner; the back wall behind the man features a wooden door with a brass ornament and a solid dark-blue coat hanging on its left stile, bare recessed wood panels behind the man's torso, a narrow vertical strip of green wall with a switch box to the right, and another wooden panel with a framed print on the far right.
00:00-00:06: An angled wooden door is positioned on the left wall perpendicular/angled to the back wall.
00:07-00:09: The man turns left and steps toward the left-hand wooden door to knock on it as the camera pans left, revealing a green wall strip with brass chimes/switches to the left of that door.

00:07-00:08: During the leftward pan, the back wall to the right of the hanging coat changes layout: the bare wooden panels and green wall strip with the switch box vanish, replaced by a framed emblem print mounted immediately to the right of the coat (which now also displays a white horizontal stripe).

findings.entity: Back wall and door panels to the right of the hanging coat
findings.description: At 00:00-00:06, the section of the back wooden door immediately to the right of the hanging blue coat consists of bare recessed wood panels, followed by a doorframe, a strip of green wall with a switch box, and a separate wooden panel on the far right with a framed picture. As the man turns left and the camera pans left at 00:07-00:08, the bare door panels and the green wall section with the switch box disappear entirely, and a framed picture now hangs directly on the wooden panel immediately adjacent to the coat.
